mentions.name: Townhall Tracker
mentions.description: This app helps Canadians keep tabs on their city council, tracking municipal government activity so residents can stay informed and participate in decisions that affect their day-to-day lives.
mentions.problem: People often miss municipal elections and local council activity; the author didn't realize a municipal election was happening in their new city until a councillor knocked on their door.
mentions.audience: Canadians who want to follow their local municipal government
mentions.source_excerpt: Building https://www.townhall-tracker.ca to help me and other Canadians keep tabs on their city council.
